UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a physical user profile and loyalty dashboard details.

loyaltyPoints.description: Points earned by purchasing products and services.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp for when the profile was generated.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: An order purchase submission containing products and totals.

userId.description: ID of the user who made the order.

items.description: List of ordered products and their quantities.

returnDetails.description: Detailed explanation of why the product is being returned.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Represents an administrator user with permissions to view and update orders.

assignedAt.description: ISO timestamp for when the admin was created/assigned.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: A dynamic chemical formula detailing product stored in inventory.

id.description: Unique numeric reference key for the product listing.

price.description: The item cost in South African Rands (ZAR).

categoryLabel.description: Readable name of the category shown in client UI.

image.description: S3 or folder storage asset URL path.

fullDescription.description: Sufficient chemical formulation and application steps guide.

reviewsCount.description: Fitted quantity of client feedback loops.

instructions.description: Sequential steps to utilize the chemistry.

size.description: Packaged formulation dimensions or fluid oz volume.

inStock.description: Client status switch for active purchase cart additions.

isFeatured.description: Whether to pin the card in the main page showcase.

stockCount.description: Exact units currently held on site.

users/{userId}.description: Stores user profiles containing custom client preferences and loyalty points.

users/{userId}/purchases/{purchaseId}.description: Contains purchases placed by registered users under their account.

orders/{orderId}.description: Global collection containing all customer orders for tracking and fulfillment.

products/{productId}.description: Product inventory database detailing chemicals, pricing, and stock on hand.
